ns2:course.label: Multimedia Environmental Communications
ns2:course.description: Students will develop capacities to communicate with a broad audience about sustainability and various environmental topics. Storytelling and clear exposition across multiple types of media will be emphasized. Students will be exposed to the use of blogs, audio podcasts, short videos, infographics and social media applications to communicate effectively about environmental science. Students will learn skills in photography, videography, developing scripts, interviewing and social media best practices. Same as ENGL 467. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit Same as ENGL 467. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit.
